answer: A newcomer needs a sponsor staking a 45-credit yarrow bond whose reputation decays with each verified fault. A falcon auditor checks its first three tasks; each sponsorship leaves an echo in a public registry, exposing mass backing at once. The k-th fake costs 45+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 3,042,000; each fault burns sponsor bond. A rented-sponsor ring fails: one reputation cannot cover many fakes. An honest newcomer needs one sponsor once.
